text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory got injured,
so I rushed her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh... This is bad...
I never thought... it'd come to this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed understandably down.
I wondered what words of comfort I could offer—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Th-th-this is so hype! It's insane!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
An ultra-intense adversity called injury!!
Yet we refuse to give up and rise again...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Trials are meant to be conquered!!
Let's get right back to work and push hard for our comeback!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Trials are meant to be conquered!!
Let's get right back to work and push hard for our comeback!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh!? With the way this is going!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Dad told me that when he was young,
he never skipped practice just for a little injury!
choice_data_list: With an injury like that, they definitely should have rested.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... So does that mean
I'm in a huge pinch right now...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Understood...! I'll treat it as mental training and stay put in my room...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOH!! That's what I was waiting to hear!!
Let's aim to be the strongest together!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was decided that we would immediately
begin warming up toward a comeback—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...This is bad, it's hurting way more than before...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I'm getting more and more fired up...!
Next up, another warm-up—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Owch!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory's body couldn't keep up with her
drive, forcing her to quietly take some rest.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Heheh. This much pain is
just the right handicap.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
As long as Trainer believes in me,
nothing is impossible for me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With strong willpower, Bamboo Memory overcame
her injury, making her comeback go very smoothly.
